faqs.q: What are the Baldwin hydraulic elements used for?
faqs.a: Baldwin hydraulic elements are replacement hydraulic filter elements with two gaskets and a reinforced centre tube, listed in 430 part numbers such as H9007, PT416 and PT546. They fit hydraulic filter housings and machines by part number.

faqs.q: What part numbers are listed for the Baldwin hydraulic elements?
faqs.a: The Baldwin hydraulic elements are listed as 430 part numbers, for example H9007, PT8951-MPG and PT9315 KIT. Quote the part number, or the size you need, and we confirm the match before supply.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size or model of the Baldwin hydraulic elements?
faqs.a: Choose by the part number of the element being replaced, such as H9007 or PT9239, or by the dimensions and media. The 430 part numbers carry many different item descriptions, so quote the number from the old element.

faqs.q: What pressure rating do the Baldwin hydraulic elements have?
faqs.a: The listing gives no pressure rating on its rows for the Baldwin hydraulic elements, so we do not quote one. Quote the part number and we confirm the rated pressure and flow with the maker.

faqs.q: What are the Baldwin hydraulic elements made from?
faqs.a: The listing gives the seal and media materials of the Baldwin hydraulic elements in its specification, and does not state a housing material beyond that. Check the seal material against your fluid before ordering.

faqs.q: Which standards and documents apply to the Baldwin hydraulic elements?
faqs.a: The listing names no ISO or SAE standard for the Baldwin hydraulic elements and holds no certificates. Filtration ratings are normally set by the ISO 16889 multi-pass test and oil cleanliness is reported as an ISO 4406 code, but the listing gives neither a beta rating nor a code, so ask in the enquiry if you need the maker's test data.

faqs.q: What do the Baldwin hydraulic elements connect to?
faqs.a: The Baldwin hydraulic elements fit the housing or bowl of the series it is made for, so match the element part number to the filter head. Quote the part number of the element or housing being replaced, or the filter rating, seal material and dimensions, and we confirm the match before supply.

faqs.q: How should the Baldwin hydraulic elements be installed and maintained?
faqs.a: Replace the Baldwin hydraulic elements when the filter indicator shows the change zone, or on the maker's schedule, and fit the new seals with it. Depressurise first, keep dirt out of the bowl, and flush if the system has been contaminated. Do not wash and refit a disposable element.

faqs.q: Which industries and jobs use the Baldwin hydraulic elements?
faqs.a: The Baldwin hydraulic elements are used as replacement filter elements for hydraulic and lube oil filters on power units, mobile machines and industrial plant, keeping the oil clean.

faqs.q: How do the Baldwin hydraulic elements differ from the Baldwin hydraulic filter elements?
faqs.a: These 430 elements include gaskets and a reinforced centre tube, while [the Baldwin hydraulic filter elements](/p/baldwin-hydraulic-filter-elements) are 116 elements with end seals attached. Choose by the part number of the old element.
